title: Periods and groups
caption: Rows are periods: the period number is the number of occupied electron shells. Columns are groups: elements in a group share their outer electron configuration, so they react alike. Group 1, group 17 and group 18 are highlighted.
alt: The periodic table with groups 1 to 18 numbered across the top and periods 1 to 7 down the side; groups 1, 17 and 18 highlighted.
description: Group numbers 1 to 18 across the top, period numbers 1 to 7 down the left.
Group 1 (the alkali metals) highlighted on the left.
Group 17 (the halogens) and group 18 (the noble gases) highlighted on the right.
notes: orange: group 1 · green: group 17 · purple: group 18
